title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
SRE for NOC - 1st/2nd Line Support

**Supporting USA Time Zone - 7am to 5pm Pacific time**


Skills

  • SRE
  • Network Operations Centre experience
  • Incident Management - Troubleshoot and Raise Tickets
  • Linux Environment (Commands)
  • Python Scripting
  • Cloud - GCP/AWS


Overview

We are seeking an experienced NOC Support Analyst to join our 24/7 monitoring team. In this role, you will be responsible for proactive system monitoring , first‑line troubleshooting , and escalation to second‑ and third‑line teams when required. Each shift is staffed by two engineers, with one acting as the Manager on Duty (MOD) .


This position is ideal for someone with solid NOC experience who is also looking for career growth opportunities in Automation , SRE , and systems optimisation .


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor infrastructure, applications, and services to ensure availability and performance.
  • Perform initial triage and first‑line troubleshooting of incidents.
  • Escalate issues appropriately after initial diagnosis.
  • Act as Manager on Duty when assigned, coordinating incident response.
  • Contribute to automation improvements , tooling enhancements , and SRE initiatives .
  • Support staging and pre‑production activities aimed at improving production stability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to refine processes and reduce manual intervention.


Required Experience

  • Prior experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) or similar operations environment.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring tools, incident workflows, and operational best practices.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, 24/7 environment with shared responsibility across shifts.


Ideal Candidate Profile

This role may be a great fit for:

  • A Junior Software Engineer with an interest in operational systems, automation, and reliability engineering.
  • Someone eager to grow into an SRE -focused position through hands-on exposure and mentorship.
  • A candidate passionate about operational excellence and continuously improving system reliability.

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital sowie Angular Ventures. Mit Hauptsitzen in Deutschland und Chicago ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen massiv steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager , der die strategisch wichtigsten Kundenbeziehungen von Levity mit globalen Logistikführern verantwortet und ausbaut (z. B. Gebrüder Weiss, LKW Walter). Du übernimmst Accounts nach dem Sales-Abschluss mit dem Ziel, daraus Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich zu entwickeln.

Dies ist keine rein administrative Bestandskundenrolle. Es ist eine kommerzielle Position mit hohem Impact, Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen und das Vorantreiben signifikanter Umsatzexpansion. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Du verantwortest ein fokussiertes Portfolio von 3 bis 5 hochwertigen Enterprise Accounts.
  • Revenue Expansion: Du treibst starkes Wachstum innerhalb bestehender Accounts voran, indem du neue Abteilungen, Regionen und Use Cases erschließt.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du analysierst komplexe Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives sowie operativen Champions über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften hinweg auf.
  • Commercial Strategy: Du führst Vertragsverhandlungen und Renewals und entwickelst Kunden hin zu langfristigen, großvolumigen Commitments.
  • Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um eine erfolgreiche Delivery sicherzustellen.
  • Travel: Regelmäßige Reisen zu Kundenstandorten (z. B. Hamburg, Wien, Belgien oder USA), um persönliche Beziehungen vor Ort zu pflegen.


DEIN PROFIL

  • Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Enterprise Account Management oder Sales, insbesondere in der Betreuung multinationaler Accounts.
  • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Umfeld ist essenziell. Du bist hands-on, denkst unternehmerisch und besitzt eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität.
  • AI & Tech Fluency: Du bist kein Engineer, kannst aber mit technischen Führungskräften auf Augenhöhe über den Nutzwert von KI-Workflows sprechen.
  • Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (C2) sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch sind zwingende Voraussetzungen.
  • Industry Background: Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL ist ein großes Plus. Wir sind jedoch offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen (Telco, Manufacturing, etc.).


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Equity.
  • Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.
  • Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Chance, unser Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Flexibility: Remote-Work von überall in Europa oder hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Berliner Büro.
  • Team: Ein internationales, talentiertes Team aus über 20 Mitgliedern weltweit.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail. If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Information Technology Governance Consultant
description:
Remote

Long-term contractor - PJ

Salary - 25-30hr USD


Required Skills & Experience


• ITGC / SOX Readiness Lead

• SOX IT Controls Manager

• IT Risk & Controls Manager

• Senior IT Auditor who moved into readiness or Line 1.5 roles

• IPO or public-company SOX experience

• Personally designed IT General Controls (not just reviewed them)

• Executed management / interim testing before audits

• Owned SOX readiness end-to-end

• Partnered with IT, Engineering, and Finance

• Strong PCAOB and IPE fluency

ITGC Design & Testing: Access, change, IT ops controls; control narratives; management testing

SOX & PCAOB: COSO alignment, walkthroughs, remediation

IPE: Source systems, queries, completeness & accuracy validation

Modern Tech: SaaS, cloud, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD evidence


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


CISA strongly preferred

• CRISC, CISSP, CPA are a plus

• Experience outweighs certification


Job Description


A client of Insight Global is seeking a highly experienced ITGC & SOX Readiness Lead to serve as the central architect and owner of our IT General Controls (ITGC) program. This is a strategic GRC role designed for a hands-on leader who goes beyond checklist testing to partner deeply with Engineering, IT, and Finance to build scalable, defensible, and audit-ready controls.

This is not an Internal Audit role. Instead, you will operate as a “Line 1.5” enablement and readiness leader, responsible for ensuring controls are properly scoped, well-designed, automated where possible, and operating effectively before Internal and External Auditors begin formal validation.

You will own the full ITGC readiness lifecycle—from scoping and control design to interim self-testing, remediation, and audit coordination—ensuring predictable outcomes and eliminating last-minute surprises.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. The ideal candidate is expected to contribute to a positive engineering culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today processing $5 Billion in daily sales.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and support existing systems as well as create new functionality for the OrderAI platform, with a focus on LLM-powered features, including building AI features, integrating LLM APIs, and working with prompts and voice systems
  • Write high-quality code following best practices and standards for coding, compliance, security, and performance using C#/.NET
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on backend design, quality, and implementation
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI and LLM technologies to improve the effectiveness of delivering business value within the AI ordering platform
  • Support and share knowledge with fellow engineers through code reviews and collaboration
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify bug fixes across systems that support AI voice ordering and backend integrations


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft technologies including C# and Azure
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Experience with queues, caching, CDNs, and other technologies used for building scalable applications
  • Demonstrated success delivering SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications/APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud environments (Azure preferred), and modern architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to work individually as well as part of a team
  • Interest in working with LLM technologies and AI-driven products


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Exposure to LLM-powered systems or AI-driven applications
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into backend systems
  • Interest in building products that leverage voice-based or conversational interfaces
  • Experience supporting real-time or event-driven systems


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: CUA Trajectory Specialist - 65129
description:

This includes tasks such as file operations, light scripting, API interactions, and browser automation.

This role requires a strong understanding of technical workflows, attention to detail, and the ability to translate natural language instructions into precise, step-by-step executable actions that can be used to train advanced AI systems.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create detailed, step-by-step positive CUA trajectories for technical tasks (e.g., file manipulation, scripting, API calls, browser-based workflows)

  • Work within Linux desktop environments to execute and document workflows

  • Strong attention to detail in documenting technical processes

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

Evaluation Process:

title: Supervisor de Manutenção
description:
Responsabilidades

O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 16 países, com mais de 2.000 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 22 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Tonus Gym, Aera, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


Em quais regiões há posições abertas?


  • SP - São Paulo – Residir na Capital
  • RJ - Rio de Janeiro - Residir na Capital
  • BA- Salvador - Residir na Capital
  • DF- Brasília – Residir Brasília ou Goiânia


O(a) Supervisor(a) de Manutenção será responsável por:

  • Realizar tarefas rotineiras sob supervisão direta.
  • Acompanhar a execução e garantir a qualidade da manutenção preventiva e corretiva junto aos prestadores, receber e validar os relatórios para pagamento via plataforma de gestão (Trilogo).
  • Inspecionar as estruturas prediais para determinar a necessidade de reparos ou restaurações, gerar relatório de visita bimestral.
  • Gerar relatório referente aos serviços de impacto nas unidades, com fotos de antes de depois da execução.
  • Receber, controlar, registrar e acompanhar as ordens de serviço, garantindo que todas as solicitações de manutenção sejam processadas de forma eficiente através da plataforma de gestão Trilogo.
  • Manter contato com fornecedores de peças e serviços de manutenção, solicitando cotações, acompanhando pedidos e recebimentos.
  • Gestão dos processos de manutenção, reparos e reformas das unidades a fim de garantir a padronização e a qualidade das instalações.
  • Gestão do cronograma e atividades dos manutencista (N1 e N2)
  • Recebimento de novas unidades, elaborando checklist de pendencias e acompanhar a regularização das pendencias.


Requisitos


Itens não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência em manutenção predial.
  • Formação em engenharia.
  • Experiência com Gestão de Equipe.


Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Nos esforçamos para manter um ambiente descontraído, onde a opinião de todos reflete nas decisões da equipe. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa e criativa. Estamos em constante evolução e sempre abertos a novas tendências.

title: Head of GTM & Growth | Valere Evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve

Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.


The Role

As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.

You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.

This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.


Impact You Will Have

  • Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
  • Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
  • Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
  • Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
  • Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
  • Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
  • Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones


Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
  • Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
  • Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
  • Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
  • Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
  • AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
  • Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities


What We Look For

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
  • AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
  • AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
  • Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
  • Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
  • Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
  • Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
  • Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2B and B2B2C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
  • Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
  • Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
  • Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
  • Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade


How to Apply

To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:

  • A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
  • A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute.

Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY:

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital, eine der renommiertesten Venture-Capital-Gesellschaften Europas, sowie Angular Ventures. 

Mit HQ in Deutschland und Chicago und einer globalen Präsenz ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen, indem sie die Erstellung und Implementierung von Automatisierungen über eine einfache visuelle Benutzeroberfläche ermöglicht. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre Workflows optimieren, manuelle Arbeit reduzieren und die operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE DES ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE:

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive , der ein neues Geschäft vorantreibt und strategische Partnerschaften mit globalen Marktführern in der Logistik aufbaut. Du bist verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss von hochkarätigen Enterprise-Kunden, mit dem Ziel, langfristige Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich aufzubauen.

Dies ist eine kommerzielle Rolle mit großem Einfluss, mit Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen, das Identifizieren wertvoller Use Cases und das Generieren signifikanter neuer Umsätze. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.


Wesentliche Verantwortlichkeiten

• Enterprise Sales Ownership: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle für strategische Enterprise-Prospects, von der ersten Ansprache und Discovery bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

• New Revenue Generation: Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden, mit Fokus auf wirkungsstarke Use Cases und groß angelegte Deployments.

• Stakeholder Management: Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives, Entscheidungsträgern und operativen Führungskräften über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften und Länder hinweg auf.

• Commercial Strategy: Du führst kommerzielle Gespräche, entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Angebote und verhandelst Verträge, um langfristige Enterprise-Partnerschaften zu sichern.

• Collaboration: Du arbeitest während des Sales-Prozesses eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um Lösungen zu gestalten, die den Kundenanforderungen entsprechen und gleichzeitig erfolgreiche Abschlüsse ermöglichen.


Wen wir suchen und wer in dieser Rolle erfolgreich sein wird:

• Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung als Enterprise Account Executive oder im Vertrieb, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz beim Abschluss komplexer Deals innerhalb multinationaler Organisationen.

 • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Startup-Umfeld ist essenziell. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, ohne die Ressourcen eines Großkonzerns zu arbeiten. Du bist hands-on und bringst eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität mit.

• Technically competent to navigate AI discussions: Auch wenn du kein Engineer bist, wirst du mit technischen Führungskräften, Operations-Leads und deren Teams sprechen und ihnen vermitteln, welchen enormen Mehrwert Levity für ihre Organisation schaffen kann. Deshalb brauchst du ein solides Verständnis von KI sowie ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis.

• Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachiveau/C2 und fließendes Englisch. 

• Industry Background: Ein großes Plus ist Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL. Gleichzeitig sind wir offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen, z. B. Telco, Manufacturing etc.

• Gemeinsam mit den Gründern wirst du zudem das Gesicht von Levity auf Konferenzen und Events sein. Du solltest gerne reisen, um an Konferenzen teilzunehmen und Kunden weltweit zu besuchen. Die meisten Konferenzen finden in Europa und den USA statt, während sich die Kunden global verteilen. Es wird keine monatlich feste Reisetätigkeit geben, aber einige Monate werden reiseintensiver sein als andere.


Vergütung & Benefits:

• Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Bonus + Equity.

• Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.

• Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Möglichkeit, unseren Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.

• International team: Levity zählt über 20 talentierte Mitarbeitende und wächst weiter. Das Team ist in Europa (Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal, Polen, Schweden), Brasilien, APAC und weiteren Regionen vertreten.

• Remote: Du kannst von überall in Europa aus arbeiten. Levity hat außerdem ein Büro in Berlin, falls du eine hybride oder Office-basierte Rolle bevorzugst.

• Travel: Du solltest dich mit umfangreicher Reisetätigkeit wohlfühlen, um Kunden weltweit zu treffen und bei Bedarf an Konferenzen teilzunehmen.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail.
  •  If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science

Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field

Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle, from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

Se você quer uma carreira repleta de oportunidades, desafios, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador, venha para a Forvis Mazars.


Sobre Nós


Somos uma das 10 maiores empresas em prestação de serviços, reconhecidos pela nossa excelência e capacidade de fornecer uma experiência única aos nossos clientes e equipes. Acreditamos que o crescimento sustentável é alcançado através do investimento no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e novas tecnologias.

Como uma empresa global mantemos alto nível de excelência garantindo uma experiência única através de qualificação, trabalho integrado, tecnologia e desenvolvimento contínuo de nosso time.


Sua Jornada Conosco


Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.


Sobre a área


Na nossa área de auditoria, você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional com interações e responsabilidades entre as principais linhas de frente de negócio, através disso você terá um contato maior com o time no que tange ao processo de auditoria desde o início de um projeto até o fim.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Realizar procedimentos de auditoria em áreas contábeis, financeiras e fiscais, com foco em questões complexas e que demandem conhecimento especializado;
  • Analisar demonstrações financeiras e contábeis, avaliando fluxos de caixa, tributos, custos, orçamento, e controles internos;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios de auditoria e emitir pareceres sobre as demonstrações financeiras;
  • Participar no planejamento dos trabalhos de auditoria, assegurando que os objetivos e estratégias estejam bem definidos;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico à equipe e garantir que o trabalho realizado esteja em conformidade com os padrões de auditoria;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com os clientes, compreendendo o segmento de atuação e suas demandas específicas;
  • Auxiliar na formação e desenvolvimento de profissionais, fornecendo feedback técnico e orientação sobre os projetos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros auditores e gerenciar prazos para garantir a entrega dentro do cronograma.


Requisitos / Qualificações


  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Possuir CRC Ativo;
  • Excel Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento técnico e prático nas atividades contábeis e de auditoria;
  • Experiência com auditoria externa;
  • Inglês desejável


Benefícios


  • Serviço de telemedicina;
  • Gympass;
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação (Cartão Flash) – flexibilidade para o seu dia a dia;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica (Amil);
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida (SulAmérica);
  • Descontos e incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.


Se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Aqui teremos diversas oportunidades e desafios para que você possa contribuir e se desenvolver em conjunto conosco.

title: Especialista CX - Afirmativa PCD
description:
Nossa área de Customer Experience (CX) é uma das principais alavancas de retenção e eficiência do grupo. Responsável por garantir que a jornada do cliente seja fluida, o time de CX atua na intersecção entre as áreas de Comercial, Implantação e Suporte, transformando indicadores em projetos estratégicos de otimização operacional.


Como Especialista de CX e Qualidade operacional, você trabalhará com equipes multifuncionais para identificar gargalos que impactam a experiência do cliente e a performance do negócio. Você será o guardião dos Fóruns de Qualidade, liderando os esforços desde o diagnóstico de indicadores até a implementação de novos fluxos de trabalho.


É uma função de ritmo acelerado e alta visibilidade, onde o foco é a resolução de problemas complexos. O Especialista lidera a conexão entre os silos da organização, a consolidação de processos de atendimento e a transferência de boas práticas entre os times para garantir que o cliente alcance o sucesso no menor tempo possível.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Liderar os Fóruns de CX e Operações: Garantir o ótimo relacionamento com os líderes de Comercial, Suporte e Implantação, alinhando metas, processos e comunicação.
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Analisar e reportar o progresso de métricas críticas (TTV, CSAT, Throughput, Tempo de Resposta) em relação aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Mapeamento de Jornada: Desenhar processos e modelos de atendimento, identificando proativamente oportunidades de otimização e redução de atrito para o cliente.
  • Gestão de Projetos de Melhoria: Desenvolver e acompanhar planos de ação pós-diagnóstico, garantindo que as melhorias discutidas sejam implementadas e gerem o valor esperado.
  • Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar gargalos operacionais que possam gerar churn ou queda de satisfação e ajustar os planos de execução conforme necessário.
  • Voz do Cliente: Assegurar a disseminação de feedbacks qualitativos para toda a organização, influenciando a evolução do produto e do serviço.
  • Report Estratégico: Comunicar o progresso das iniciativas de CX e os ganhos de eficiência para os stakeholders e lideranças.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Customer Experience, CX Ops ou Gestão de Projetos Operacionais.
  • Experiência em mapeamento de processos e desenho de jornadas de cliente.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, objetiva e com foco em dados.
  • Capacidade de engajar e liderar pessoas e áreas, independente de subordinação hierárquica (influência lateral).
  • Perfil analítico e executor: Conforto em navegar entre dashboards e a implementação prática de processos.
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis ou melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma ou Design Thinking).
  • Formação superior completa.

title: Executivo Comercial - Hunter para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Campinas
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;



Requisitos:

  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em Campinas, SP.
  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:

HBX Group is the world's leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We're game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to 'move fast, dream big and make the difference' every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our 'global approach, local touch' mentality. We're headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.

We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers. This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí.

Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.

If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!

Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Analista De Crédito E Cobrança Pleno
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.

A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.

Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.

Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

Descrição Resumida:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio na análise de crédito: Responsável pela análise da capacidade de crédito dos clientes e na tomada de decisões com base nas políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso envolve a revisão de relatórios de crédito, demonstrações financeiras e históricos de pagamento para avaliar o risco de crédito, fazer liberação emergencial de limite de crédito, realizar validação e revisão cadastral dos clientes, realizar bloqueio e desbloqueio de cadastro conforme política interna.
  • Faturamento: Atuar no processo de faturamento, enviando faturas aos clientes de forma precisa e pontual. Isso inclui verificar as informações de cobrança, aplicar descontos ou ajustes apropriados e resolver divergências de faturamento.
  • Assistência na cobrança: Responsável nas atividades de cobrança, entrando em contato com clientes para acompanhar pagamentos em atraso e resolver pendências. Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou experiência equivalentes;
  • Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades de negociação.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com comprovada capacidade de resolução de disputas.
  • Conhecimento de atividades de crédito, cobrança e contas a receber.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial

Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Customer Engagement & Account Support

  • Act as an advocate for both customers and internal teams by identifying process gaps, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities for improvement.

CRM & Data Hygiene (Pipedrive)

  • Keep Pipedrive records current for organizations and deals, ensuring required fields are completed for reporting, visibility, and handoffs.
  • Flag repeat manual work that should be automated and document requirements clearly for Dev.

Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills
  • 3+ years in customer success, operations, or administrative support.
  • 2+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong written communication and customer-facing professionalism.
  • Experience working with CRMs (Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Comfortable coordinating across Customer Success, Production, Sales, and Dev.
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to follow recurring cadences.

Preferred

  • Experience running customer trainings or onboarding sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS-style account management or subscription services.
  • Process documentation or SOP experience.

Why This Role Matters

This position is not just support—it is a force multiplier. By owning recurring customer and data workflows, this role directly enables Headshots.Com to scale accounts, improve retention, and transition from manual effort to system-driven growth.

IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.Com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Programa Jovem Aprendiz 2026
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?

O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.

  • Atender outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao programa.

Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga?

  • Ensino médio cursando ou completo
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office

Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Refeitório no local (para os dias presenciais no Complexo Butantan);

  • Ônibus fretado - Instituto Butantan/ Metrô/Instituto Butantan;

  • Descontos em parcerias de entretenimentos;
  • Ingressos para os museus do Butantan;
  • Totalpass – benefício focado na saúde e bem estar dos colaboradores;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e auto avaliação;
  • Participação empalestras e Workshops realizados no Butantan;
  • Mentoria;
  • Day Off de aniversário – O (a) Aprendiz terá direito a uma folga no mês do aniversário, acordado com a gestão.

Informações complementares:

Período de inscrições: 16/03/2026 a 30/03/2026

Quantidade de vaga(s): 60

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil

Horário de trabalho: 08h às 14h15 ou 12h às 18h15

title: Immigration Attorney (Us-Licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS

ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy: Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client's unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to, referencing\ "Immigration Attorney position".

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.

The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.

What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety

What we're looking for

  • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.

As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.

About iCore

iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.

Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.

Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.

Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.

Objectives:

  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns

Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.G., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments

Benefits:

Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.

  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.

  • Work with a mission-driven team

You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.

  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.

  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.

  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.

Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.

  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.

  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.

  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.

  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.

What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position

You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!
